mentions.name: Meetinghouse
mentions.description: A web app for Twitter users to find and be found by one another, positioned as an extension of an existing social network rather than a new social network. It also functions as a link-tree-like site with profile pages.
mentions.source_excerpt: A place to find and be found for twitter users only right now. As a silly project I am trying to make not a social network, but an extension of another social network. So far its going OK. It also functions as a link-tree like site with profiles: https://meetinghouse.cc/x/simonsarris
